name: SPZ Packed Format
definition: A binary format for storing 3D Gaussian splats with low-precision, non-interleaved storage. It uses ZSTD compression and supports variable spherical harmonics (SH) degrees up to 4. The format is identified by the magic number `0x5053474e`.
summary: SPZ Packed Format is a binary storage format for 3D Gaussian splats that uses ZSTD compression and parallel attribute buffers to enable efficient serialization and transmission of large-scale datasets.
